messages:
Ravi (docs): Quick sync 14a14a14a14a14a
Drafting the small user-facing patch note for Friday's docs deploy. Need: one short customer-facing blurb, a tiny migration-snippet for SDK constructor/param changes, and a short Known Issues list for the docs page. Anyone have fresh items? :mag:

Nora (eng): Two items from runtime: 1) Changed KV cache eviction policy to lower memory at high concurrency (helps cost) but adds slightly longer cold-start latency for unusually long contexts. 2) Websocket shim still has an edge-case where http streaming is safer for embeddings on models < 2.1. I'll paste repro and a mitigation in a sec.

Omar (sdk): We're shipping two small breaking-ish conveniences: `max_tokens` is now accepted as an alias for `token_limit` (we'll warn for one release), and the JS client accepts an options object instead of positional args. I'll provide one-line migration examples for both (old && new).

Hana (product): Keep the customer blurb short and optimistic. Suggest: "Lower token costs for common chat patterns; you may see slightly longer initial warm-up for very long contexts." That should be first line.

Ravi (docs): Using that exact sentence. For the migration snippets, please keep them tiny (1-2 lines) and copy-pasteable. We also need a short "If you see regressions" section with commands to search/replace client usage and a link to the runtime changelog.

Omar (sdk): Here are the tiny snippets:

```js
// constructor: old -> new
const client = new RedwoodClient(apiKey, 'gpt-4-mini')
// new
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey, model: 'gpt-4-mini' })

// param alias: both work for now
client.generate({ prompt, token_limit: 200 })
client.generate({ prompt, max_tokens: 200 }) // alias, will warn
```

```py
# constructor: old -> new
client = RedwoodClient('API_KEY', 'gpt-4-mini')
# new
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='API_KEY', model='gpt-4-mini')

# param alias
resp = client.generate(prompt, token_limit=200)
resp = client.generate(prompt, max_tokens=200)  # alias, warning
```

Pri (devex): I'll add a small CI lint to examples that greps for positional constructors and flags them. Will open PR today. Also adding a test that calls both `max_tokens` and `token_limit` to ensure runtime compatibility.

Nora (eng): Repro steps for websocket embedding truncation (will include link to runtime issue):
1) Use legacy websocket shim + model gpt-2.9 / any model < 2.1
2) Send a batched embed request with streaming enabled
3) Observe last token missing in ~1/2000 requests
Mitigation: switch to http streaming or upgrade to runtime build 2026.03.12. Link: https://ci.internal/runtime/changes/2026-03-12

Hana (product): Also call out the broken anchor redirects we fixed in the embeddings guide. One short example mapping is fine in the notes so users who bookmarked old anchors are not confused.

Nora (eng): Example redirect: `/docs/api/embeddings#batching` -> `/docs/api/embeddings#batch-usage`. I'll drop the full map into the PR.

CI-Bot: staging docs build queued for branch `release/docs-217777`  logs: https://ci.internal/builds/217777 :gear:

Ravi (docs): Action items: Omar -> paste the diff/PR for snippet updates, Nora -> paste full redirect map + runtime link, Pri -> PR for CI tests, Hana -> final sign-off of customer blurb. I'll assemble the patch-note draft and post here for quick copy-edit by Thursday EOD.

Hana (product): Approved. Keep public blurb to one sentence.

Omar (sdk): PRs: sdk#778 (snippets), sdk#779 (compat warning). Will link when ready.

Pri (devex): PR opened: examples#121 (CI lint + compat test).

Ravi (docs): I'll post the draft now (attaching short doc page content + relnote bullet) for one-line edits. Thanks all! :tada:
